title: Different Views, Themes, Delivery & Certificate
summary: Two layouts, any number of themes, three delivery modes and a configurable certificate — all without touching the code.

tabs.label: Sidebar
tabs.md: Contents on the **left**, content next to it. Topics expand to show subtopics. The ☰ button slides the panel in and out. Best for long trainings on desktop.

tabs.label: Top bar
tabs.md: Content uses the **full width**. Topics sit in a bar at the **top**; the arrow opens a drop-down with subtopics. The ☰ button shows / hides the bar.

blocks.title: Try it now
blocks.md: Open **View ▾** in the header and switch the layout. Set the default in `training.json` → `"layout": "sidebar" | "topbar"`.
A theme is a small CSS file with **variables only** (colours, fonts, corner radius). Three are included: *foundation*, *midnight* (dark) and *paper*.
New look? Ask the AI: *create a theme `css/themes/ocean.css` with teal accent and rounded corners*, then add `"ocean"` to `themes` in `training.json`.
The same training can be delivered in three ways:

rows: a link or a file you send to students
students log in to a portal and continue on any device

items.title: How to open each mode
items.md:
- `index.html` or `dist/training.html` → standalone
- `index.html?mode=preview` or `dist/training-preview.html` → preview
- a platform embeds the training and passes the user and the saved progress → platform

items.title: How a platform saves progress
items.md: Three options: a **REST URL** the training reads and writes, an **iframe** whose parent page receives `progress` messages, or a **JavaScript adapter** on the same page. All of them store one JSON object per user and training. See `INTEGRATION.md`.

blocks.md:
After the last quiz the **Certificate** item unlocks. The student types a name and can print it or save it as PDF.

Everything on it comes from `certificate.json`: title, texts with placeholders like `{name}`, `{training}`, `{score}`, `{date}`, signatures, logo, and the style — `design` (*classic*, *modern*, *minimal*), `font`, and colours.

blocks.title: See it before finishing
blocks.md: Open the training in **preview** mode (`?mode=preview` or `dist/training-preview.html`): the Certificate page shows a sample certificate with controls for design, font, orientation and colours, and the matching `style` JSON.
